name: Ginger Ale
siboNotes: Carbonation may worsen SIBO symptoms by increasing gas and bloating. Choose brands with real ginger for anti-inflammatory benefits.
preparationTips: Choose brands with real ginger rather than artificial flavoring
Check labels for high fructose corn syrup which increases FODMAP load
Consider flat ginger ale if carbonation causes discomfort
Dilute with water to reduce sugar concentration if needed
alternatives: Fresh ginger tea with a pinch of sugar
Sparkling water with fresh ginger slices
Homemade ginger water with glucose or dextrose
nutritionalHighlights: Provides quick energy from simple sugars
Can help with nausea and digestive comfort
